dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: *sigh* Even after doing the calculations twice, I'm still coming up a little short...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: Yes, I'm a logistics buyer for the Akademiya. I mainly purchase things like spices and blankets.

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: I said I'm a buyer, but the reality is that most of my time working is spent on calculating prices and applying for budgets...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: See you. I have to prepare another pitch for a new budget application...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Akademiya wants to purchase these things...?

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: That's right. After all, researchers, students, and other staff all need to sleep and eat.

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: The Akademiya may have a handle on knowledge, but they still depend on the people for production and need to purchase daily supplies from the private sectors on a regular basis.

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: However, the Akademiya also provides everyone with free healthcare, imparts knowledge through the Akasha Terminal, and covers the costs of holding necessary festival celebrations.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Akademiya wants to purchase these things too...?

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: The Akademiya may have a handle on knowledge, but they still depend on the people for production and need to purchase daily supplies from the private sector on a regular basis.

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: In return, the Akademiya will also provide free healthcare to all and helps foot the bill for any festivals and celebrations that may need to be held.

dialogues.speaker: Sanad
dialogues.text: My dear sister, uh, may I ask a... um... favor?

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: Why are you talking to me like that? Don't tell me you've got yourself into some trouble at the Akademiya!

dialogues.speaker: Sanad
dialogues.text: No, not at all! Everything's fine with school!

dialogues.speaker: Sanad
dialogues.text: I just want to borrow your theses!

dialogues.speaker: Sanad
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I won't copy them! I just need some reference materials! Yeah, that's what they are for, reference only!

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: Well, I can lend them to you, but my research back then is probably out of date now.

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: What's more, if it's something of reference value, it's probably already archived in the Akasha. Why don't you apply for access?

dialogues.speaker: Zohreh
dialogues.text: Instead of borrowing my out-of-date theses, why don't you discuss your ideas with top students in your school?

dialogues.speaker: Sanad
dialogues.text: My roommate is indeed a top achiever... One could even say he's an overacheiver. No one can understand the things he writes in his assignments except for our mentors.

dialogues.speaker: Sanad
dialogues.text: *sigh* Speaking of him, I bet he must be burning midnight oil now. I should bring him some food and coffee on my way back.
